phases.name: Bootstrap and CI wiring
actions: Create pyproject.toml with console_scripts entry 'schema-lens=schema_lens.cli:main' and extras [dev] for test/lint.
Add .ops/config.yml with install, lint, unit, and integration test commands; reference in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Seed .gitignore for Python, venv, cache, and out/ artifacts.

phases.name: Configuration and query ingestion
actions: Implement schema_lens/config/changeset.py to extend existing format with vector and scenario sections (backward compatible loaders).
Implement schema_lens/config/query_source.py dataclasses for QuerySource and QueryCase; support reading from JSONL (params or json_request).
Implement schema_lens/io/jsonl.py with strict line-by-line parsing, validation, and deterministic sampling (seeded).

phases.name: Solr client and replay runner
actions: Implement schema_lens/replay/solr_client.py to send /select requests using either param dicts or JSON Request API payloads; include timeouts, retries, and response normalization (id, score, numFound, QTime).
Implement schema_lens/replay/runner.py to execute scenarios: baseline (lexical), vector-only, hybrid (Solr-native vs client-side blend); persist per-scenario outputs deterministically to out/.

phases.name: Vector layer and analytics
actions: Implement schema_lens/vector/validation.py to validate vector field presence/dimension vs changeset; allow explicit overrides.
Implement schema_lens/vector/blend.py with linear blend and normalization options (none, minmax, zscore), union candidate set, and deterministic tie-breaking.
Implement schema_lens/vector/metrics.py for overlap@K, tau@K (tie-safe approx), churn, dominance, and contribution estimate with confidence.
Implement schema_lens/vector/sensitivity.py to sweep blend weights and detect tipping points; write out/hybrid_sensitivity.json.

phases.name: Reporting and CLI
actions: Implement schema_lens/report/vector_hybrid.py to summarize scenarios, metrics, and per-query drilldowns; mark native vs simulated blending.
Extend schema_lens/cli.py with flags --scenario, --enable-sensitivity, --weights, --vector-dimension-override; maintain legacy defaults.

phases.name: Examples and Docker integration
actions: Provide examples for queries (mix of params and JSON Request API), embeddings, and a changeset demonstrating baseline/vector/hybrid.
Add Solr docker-compose with configset including vector field; bootstrap/wait scripts; keep dataset small for CI.
Gate docker/integration steps under pytest -m integration.

phases.name: Documentation and polish
actions: Update README with vector/hybrid overview, config examples, CLI flags, limitations, and deterministic behavior notes.
Ensure all outputs are stable given a fixed seed and that defaults avoid Docker-only paths.

backward_compatibility: Existing changesets without vector sections continue to run unchanged.
CLI defaults mirror current behavior unless new flags are specified.
determinism: Central RNG seeded from changeset or default (e.g., 1337) for sampling and tie-breaking.
Stable output ordering using secondary keys (id) when scores tie.

test_sequence.name: Environment setup
notes: Installs package in editable mode with dev dependencies.
Set SCHEMA_LENS_SEED=1337 in test environment for stability.

test_sequence.name: Static analysis
notes: Style and lint checks; keeps codebase consistent.

test_sequence.name: Unit tests (no Docker)
covers: Query parsing for params and JSON Request API
artifacts: out/* unit artifacts are minimal; no Solr required

test_sequence.name: Start Solr for integration
notes: Waits for Solr to be healthy before tests.

test_sequence.name: Integration tests (Docker)
covers: Baseline, vector-only, and hybrid scenarios via Solr client
Report and sensitivity artifacts creation and schema validation

test_sequence.name: Teardown Docker
notes: Removes containers and volumes to keep CI clean.

risk_controls.risk: Solr version variance for vector similarity and JSON Request API
controls: Feature detection via /admin/info/system and /schema endpoints; gracefully degrade or require explicit overrides.
Normalized JSON Request construction with tolerant parsing; fall back to params when feasible.
Document supported Solr versions in README.

risk_controls.risk: Schema inspection may not expose vector dimension
controls: Validate against changeset-declared dimension; if unknown, require --vector-dimension-override.
Fail fast with human-readable errors and remediation hints.
Block replay when blank or mismatched vectors detected.

risk_controls.risk: Performance issues from large candidate unions
controls: Cap candidate sets deterministically (e.g., topK and topN) with configurable limits.
Disable debug by default; measure client elapsed separately; use efficient data structures.

risk_controls.risk: Integration test flakiness due to Solr startup
controls: Use wait-for-solr.sh with retries and timeouts.
Mark tests with -m integration and gate under Docker availability.
Increase HTTP client timeouts and include limited retries with backoff.
Label estimates with confidence levels; include methodology note in report.
Provide metrics alongside estimates (overlap, tau, churn) for context.

risk_controls.risk: Network timeouts to Solr in CI
controls: Set sensible connect/read timeouts and small retry budget in solr_client.
Surface partial results clearly and continue other queries; log summary.
Maintain default CLI behavior; only enable vector/hybrid via explicit config/flags.
Add unit tests that load legacy changesets (no vector) and assert identical code paths.
Centralize RNG seeding; sort ties by stable keys; snapshot normalization parameters in outputs.
Pin example datasets and cap sampling with recorded seeds.

notes: Core additions span new vector, replay, and report modules plus examples and CI.
LOC estimates include docstrings and tests; examples and YAML/JSONL not heavily counted.
